annotations.title: Step to the next or previous section of an extraction job's datasheet

description: The section after (direction next) or before (direction previous) the given one in reading order. scope any: the adjacent heading of any level; same_or_higher_level: skip deeper subsections. at_end=true when there is none. Deterministic: reads the job's stored parse (parsed_document_v1), calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key; readable jobs are your own, your workspace's TEAM-shared jobs and PUBLIC jobs, as on the REST API. Refusals: NOT_PARSED / PARSE_FAILED (no usable parse stored for this job), PARSE_EXPIRED (past retention), DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE (over 20,000 blocks). Every block, cell and word comes with its page, box ([x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points, origin top-left), quoted text and parse {document_sha256, parser_version, block_id, cell_id}; block ids are stable only within one parser_version.

job_id.description: An extraction job in your account (or shared with it).

section_id.description: A section id from datasheetvend_list_document_sections (the id of the heading block that opens it).
